cards.title: The Ceremony Requires More
cards.instruction: Treat every ordinary step as only the beginning of an elaborate ceremony, adding necessary details whenever anyone tries to finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The final candle needs a witness candle before we end.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can that be the last candle?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once we acknowledge its service.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we do that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Light the acknowledgement candle. We're nearly at the beginning of finishing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you blow out your birthday candle, we need a witness candle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can that be the last one? The ice cream's melting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, once we acknowledge its service.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say thank you. Then we eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Light the acknowledgement candle so everyone can see you thanking it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 and A5 add ceremonial requirements at attempted closure, but A1 starts inside an existing candle ceremony rather than an ordinary task.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's last-candle request triggers A3's acknowledgment condition; B4's method question directly triggers A5's additional candle.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants an endpoint and B4 cooperates, though the reason for finishing remains unspecified.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes acknowledgment require another candle, extending the very process B2 hoped to end.

specificity.evidence: A1 names a final candle but never establishes what ordinary activity the participants are completing.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'beginning of finishing' earns its paradox through the added acknowledgment candle.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 adds a witness candle; A3 conditions finishing on acknowledgement; A5 adds a candle for that acknowledgement.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks for the last candle, generating A3's condition; B4 offers spoken thanks, generating A5's lighting requirement.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to save melting ice cream and B4 cooperates with the ritual to reach eating.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4's attempted completion require another instance of the very object B2 wanted to stop adding.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a birthday candle and B2 supplies melting ice cream, making both the ritual and pressure immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's short condition and A5's acknowledgement candle create a precise recursive obstruction without explanation.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 requests a final candle because dessert is melting; A3 grants conditional completion through acknowledgement.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers thanks as the acknowledgement; A5 requires a new candle to illuminate those thanks.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Every attempt to finish becomes the beginning of another necessary ceremonial detail.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 recursively adds an acknowledgement candle to the witness-candle ceremony.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A converts an ordinary step into ceremony and makes each proposed finish depend on another necessary ceremonial detail.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: An elaborate existing ritual may simply have many rules; this card invents additional necessities in response to attempts to finish.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised B2 asks for the last candle and B4 offers a final thank-you; A3 and A5 make each endpoint require another observance.

records.recommendedEdit: Specified a birthday and melting dessert, retaining witness and acknowledgment candles. Internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, wit 4 = 92. A1 elaborates a familiar birthday step; B2 motivates A3's conditional assent; B4's helpful thanks becomes A5's reason for another candle. The practical deadline gives B an independent want.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. A3's 'its service' leaves the precise candle referent slightly loose.
records.writerReservation: Birthdays already contain ritual, though the recognizable act of blowing out one candle now clearly anchors the unnecessary additions.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a exploits cooperative thanks and recursive props; b turns urgent departure into a formal relationship between knots.

cards.title: The Ceremony Requires More
cards.instruction: Treat every ordinary step as only the beginning of an elaborate ceremony, adding necessary details whenever anyone tries to finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've tied the ceremonial knot. Now bless the successful tying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought the knot finished it.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After we formally introduce the two knots. They'll be travelling together.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'They'll be travelling together' supplies a compact, sincere ceremonial justification grounded in the knots.

cards.title: Reality Is Coming Apart
cards.instruction: Treat each contradiction, coincidence, and ordinary mistake as evidence that reality is losing structural integrity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a missing letter in this notice. Reality's losing components.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a typo.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Today a letter. Tomorrow the word floor stops holding us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll correct it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use permanent ink. We need structural reinforcement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your lift notice says 'third loor.' A letter's gone; the building's unravelling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my typo. I need the lift for deliveries.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me restore the F before you put any weight on that floor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's my marker. Oh, it's dried out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now matter's disappearing. Give me your delivery labels; I'll spell out every floor before we lose the stairs.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats a missing letter as missing reality; A3 extends the mistake to the floor's ability to hold people.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's typo explanation becomes A3's first stage of collapse; B4's correction offer causes A5's permanent-ink requirement.

relationship.evidence: B2 normalizes the error and B4 offers a practical repair, which A redirects into structural protection.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B4's simple correction into reinforcement of reality itself.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a notice with a missing letter, though the notice's location and purpose remain open.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's permanent ink follows the established textual-structural logic without an unrelated final joke.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats a missing F as structural collapse; A3 refuses B2's ordinary typo explanation; A5 treats a dried marker as disappearing matter.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's deliveries make A3 fear weight on the floor. B4's failed marker prevents that repair and causes A5 to seek delivery labels instead.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs the lift for deliveries, and B4 cooperates by offering a marker. A's escalating help keeps obstructing that practical aim.

heightening.evidence: B4's dried marker expands A5's repair from one missing letter to naming every floor before the stairs disappear.

specificity.evidence: A1's 'third loor' notice establishes an immediately playable location and error; B2 and B4 provide concrete delivery and repair objects.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's request to restore the F before loading the floor compresses A's entire mistaken causal model into a practical offer.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: The delivery load in B2 gives A3 a specific danger to prevent by restoring the missing letter.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: The dry marker in B4 becomes further evidence of material loss and forces A5 to substitute delivery labels.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A repeatedly interprets ordinary errors and equipment failure as damage to reality, then sincerely tries to repair it.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 broadens the threatened collapse and the attempted repair while retaining the building, lettering and deliveries.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A interprets ordinary errors as evidence that reality's structure is deteriorating and treats ordinary repairs as structural defenses.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generic catastrophizing predicts bad consequences; this card specifically interprets the mistake as physical failure of reality.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 treats restoring a printed F as restoring a load-bearing floor; A5 interprets B4's dry marker as disappearing matter and expands the textual repairs.

records.recommendedEdit: Added an illustrative lift-delivery setting, a specific typo and a failed repair tool to address the rejected generic interaction. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A1/A3 connect text loss to physical failure and A5 absorbs another ordinary mistake; logic 5, B2's deliveries motivate A3's load concern and B4's dry marker causes A5's diagnosis and label substitution; relationship 4, B2 needs access and B4 lends equipment; heightening 4, A5 commits to protecting every floor; specificity 4, A1 identifies the lift notice and its error; wit 4, A3's replacement F and A5's labels follow the same belief. Total 90. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words; internal review only.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. A5 assumes delivery labels can supply the necessary lettering; the practical method remains slightly loose.
records.writerReservation: A5's emergency spelling is deliberately surreal, and the building's actual condition remains unknown; A must sincerely believe the textual repair matters.
records.alternativeComparison: This alternative makes A a helpful physical repairer facing a delivery deadline. The preserved landlord exchange uses conversational repetition and mistaken identity to generate temporal anxiety.

cards.title: Reality Is Coming Apart
cards.instruction: Treat each contradiction, coincidence, and ordinary mistake as evidence that reality is losing structural integrity.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's hearing explanation, but A5 introduces propping a wall without establishing how it addresses B4's repetition.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains a normal communication problem and B4 offers to repeat, giving A a credible helpful partner.

heightening.evidence: A5 increases the response to physical intervention, but the wall has no prior causal connection.

specificity.evidence: A1 refers to 'that sentence' without supplying the sentence or the practical situation.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's disturbance reaching the ears is economical; A5's wall-propping feels imported.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains the repeated demand and B4 reveals the landlord, grounding B's persistence in collecting rent.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's practical written reminder into dated evidence for whether another day exists.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes rent in a flat; B4 clarifies that A is speaking directly to the landlord.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Then sound's failing too' and A5's request for a date convert ordinary clarifications into compact cosmological worries.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 suggests A did not hear; A3 incorporates that possibility as another failing physical system.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers a written reminder; A5 requests a date to test continuity of time.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A interprets repetition and possible ordinary mistakes as cumulative evidence of reality failing.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from diagnosing failures to recruiting the landlord's document as a test of tomorrow.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A treats a mundane communication mistake as evidence of failing time and sound, then seeks reassurance that reality still functions.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Avoiding an unwelcome topic could explain distraction about rent, but the card requires sincere structural concern about reality.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 diagnoses sound failure from B2's explanation; A5 uses B4's written note as a test of time continuing.

records.recommendedEdit: Added a rent conversation and landlord identity; removed the unsupported wall. Internal reread: fidelity 4, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, wit 4 = 86. A1 supplies the actual repetition; B2 causes A3's expanded diagnosis; B4's writing offer causes A5's dated test of tomorrow. The response stays within the time-and-communication concern.

cards.title: Wonderful, It’s Impossible
cards.instruction: Celebrate every impossible development as a breakthrough that removes old limitations and creates exciting new problems.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct delivery. A second breakthrough.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Finally, a reason to use the ladder indoors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The kettle's floating! Tea no longer needs a table.

beats.text: Direct delivery! We can retire the breakfast tray.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, breakfast has an upstairs! I'll rig the tray on pulleys. Ask Mum how high she likes her toast.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's upstairs movement becomes A3's delivery breakthrough, and B4's reach problem directly produces A5's ladder.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Direct delivery' and A5's indoor ladder each compress a clear character-led reinterpretation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 celebrates table-free tea, A3 celebrates tray-free delivery, and A5 welcomes ceiling breakfast as a new opportunity requiring pulleys.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's breakfast promise becomes A3's 'Direct delivery'; B4's ceiling location and request for the tray directly determine A5's pulley solution.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to fulfil a promise to Mum, and B4 brings her dissatisfied response. A sincerely helps while redefining the inconvenience as progress.

heightening.evidence: B4 defeats A3's claim that the tray is obsolete; A5 recommits by converting that same tray into an elevated breakfast system.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a floating kettle, and B2 anchors the impossibility in a familiar breakfast-in-bed obligation.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'retire the breakfast tray' earns its reversal in A5; asking how high Mum likes her toast follows the ceiling problem.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 establishes the upstairs destination and breakfast obligation that A3 recasts as automatic delivery.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 places the kettle on the ceiling and reinstates the tray; A5 combines both facts into a pulley-operated breakfast.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Each A turn celebrates a removed limitation and treats the resulting problem as an exciting design opportunity.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 advances from praising the phenomenon to proposing household infrastructure that embraces it.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A celebrates an impossibility for removing a familiar limit and welcomes its resulting practical difficulty as a new opportunity.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary positive thinking can praise any setback; this card roots the excitement in an impossible breakthrough and its new problems.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 celebrates release from tables; A3 interprets B2's upstairs movement as delivery; A5 welcomes B4's ceiling problem by committing to suspended breakfast service.

records.recommendedEdit: Added an illustrative breakfast-in-bed promise and Mum's requested remedy, replacing the slight ladder payoff. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A1/A3 celebrate removed limits and A5 welcomes the ceiling complication; logic 5, B2's breakfast promise produces A3's delivery claim and B4's tray request produces A5's pulley adaptation; relationship 4, B2/B4 pursue Mum's usable breakfast; heightening 4, A5 commits to building a service system; specificity 4, A1's kettle and B2's bedroom delivery establish the task; wit 4, A5's toast height follows suspended breakfast. cards.title: Fine, What Does It Eat?

beats.text: I'll buy in bulk. You handle feeding and cleanup.

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: The invisible guest can stay. Who takes the first feeding shift?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's immortal. I'm only house-sitting until Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me your routine before you leave. I'll arrange permanent weekend cover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't know if it eats. I've just been leaving sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Label Sunday's sandwich. I'll check weekly, and put the sandwich checks in my will.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's immortality extends A3's rota indefinitely; B4's uncertain diet causes A5's leftovers baseline.

records.recommendedEdit: Added an illustrative house-sitting handover and preserved uncertainty about appetite, strengthening B's agency and the final commitment. cards.title: Order of Business
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who decides what happens in what order. Redirect every interruption into the approved sequence.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Then we must establish whether anyone remembers them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can begin with matters arising.

cards.title: Order of Business
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who decides what happens in what order. Redirect every interruption into the approved sequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wedding speeches go father, mother, best man, bride.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bride needs to say the groom hasn't arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That information belongs in her speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't start without him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then his absence is holding up four perfectly prepared speakers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wedding speeches go father, mother, best man, bride.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bride needs to say the groom hasn't arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That information belongs in her speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me to announce it now. The guests are leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Father introduces mother, mother introduces best man, best man introduces you as the bride's spokesperson. No anecdotes; we can get there in thirty seconds.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 sets the speaking order and A3 assigns the missing-groom news to the bride's slot, but A5 only complains about delay.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's proposed announcement; A5 acknowledges B4's inability to start without giving it a procedural place.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 press a credible wedding problem that obstructs A's planned speeches.

heightening.evidence: A5 restates the obstruction as harm to prepared speakers rather than extending control over sequence.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies wedding speeches and a clear order; B2 supplies the missing groom.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'four perfectly prepared speakers' expresses misplaced concern but supplies little new action.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 dictates the speaking order, A3 assigns urgent news to its approved slot, and A5 accelerates that same sequence without surrendering control.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's news is assigned to the bride's speech in A3; B4's delegated announcement and departing guests cause A5's spokesperson chain and thirty-second limit.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 represent the bride's need to inform guests immediately. A5 accommodates that need while controlling how access to the floor is obtained.

heightening.evidence: B4 makes delay untenable, so A5 intensifies procedural commitment by compressing every required speaker into a rapid introduction relay.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes wedding speeches immediately; B2 supplies the missing groom and B4 the departing guests. A's organising role is clear without a title.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 is long but its repeated introductions enact the compulsory sequence; 'No anecdotes' makes the attempt to help comically precise.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies the bride's announcement; A3 locates that information within the established order.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 authorises B as spokesperson and introduces guests leaving; A5 preserves the order through accelerated introductions ending with B.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A continually decides sequence, even when sincere accommodation requires reducing the approved stages to seconds.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes the procedure more elaborate under urgency while proposing an actionable next move rather than resolving the wedding.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A claims control of the event's order and accommodates interruptions only by routing them through that sequence.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Blindly refusing change can produce obstruction; this card can adapt tactics while preserving A's control over the order.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A5 retains father, mother and best man in A1's order, then places B explicitly in the bride's slot as her spokesperson in response to B4.

records.recommendedEdit: Corrected only the rejected ending's missing best man and ambiguous substitution; retained the existing wedding setting and first four candidate turns.
